text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …I couldn't do it. I couldn't win. Yet again…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I failed to meet everyone's expectations. My father, my mother, the whole Satono family… and even yours.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's start again from square one. If all of my effort thus far has fallen short, it only means I have to work even harder.
choice_data_list: Let's go for broke! You and me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's okay! I'll get through any training necessary in order to win next time!
choice_data_list: Start by taking some deep breaths.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: In… and out… Innnnn… and out…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Nothing is going to keep me down! Let's keep going together!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But if we're going broke, I guess I better get my wallet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Going for broke" is just a saying but, either way, she seems to have cheered up a bit. We're both going to get back up and keep working.
